title: Taiping Rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Taiping Rebellion", at revision 1379793931, opens: "The Taiping Rebellion (1850–1864) was a civil war in late imperial China fought between the ruling Qing dynasty and the rebelling Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. It was the deadliest civil war in history and the second-deadliest conflict in history overall. Estimates of the war's death toll range from 20–30 million, around 5–10% of the total Chinese population at the time, to 73–100 million, around 25% of the population. The Rebellion is widely considered to be the most important event in 19th-century Chinese history, and although the kingdom was defeated, the victory came at a great cost to the Qing dynasty's economy and political stability." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q192408, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Qing Dynasty era rebellion (1851–1864)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: The Wikidata import wrote this lane from the event's own point. The event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
